title: Developing the Next Generation
author: CSK Media & Youth Staff
excerpt: Young players from local schools have started training and playing alongside CSK players, giving them the opportunity to experience a competitive cricket environment from an early age.
content:
As Cayman Super Kings continues to grow, the club is also committed to developing the next generation of cricketers.

Young players from local schools have started training and playing alongside CSK players, giving them the opportunity to experience a competitive cricket environment from an early age.

Pathway to Competitive Leather-Ball Cricket

Through regular training, match experience, and interaction with experienced players, these young cricketers are able to develop their skills, confidence, discipline, and understanding of the game.

CSK is proud to provide a pathway for aspiring young players to learn, grow, and pursue their ambitions in cricket, with the hope of helping them progress towards playing competitive and professional cricket in the future.

title: CSK Qualifies for Knockout Stages in Historic T10 Tournament Campaign
author: CSK Media Team
excerpt: Captain Rahul Garg leads CSK to the knockout stages of the T10 tournament in one of the club's biggest milestones.
content:
Year after year, Cayman Super Kings continued to develop skills and fight hard regardless of opposition, producing one of the club's biggest moments: qualifying for the knockout stages of the T10 tournament under skipper Rahul Garg.

For a team built largely through development, determination, and a shared love for cricket, reaching the knockouts represents an important milestone—and a sign of how far the club has come.

Co-founders Majin Paul and Christopher Balraj praised the squad's dedication: 'Being the underdog became part of the CSK identity, but reaching the knockouts proves that our belief and teamwork can overcome any obstacle.'

title: Taking CSK to the International Stage
author: CSK Media Team
excerpt: Christopher Balraj and Rahul Garg represent Cayman Super Kings in international T10 leagues and World Cup Qualifiers.
content:
The growth of CSK has also been reflected in the individual journeys of its players.

Christopher Balraj reached a major milestone representing the Cayman Islands national team in Bermuda for the Sub-Regional World Cup Qualifiers. Rahul Garg took the next step in his cricketing journey playing in the 2024 international T10 league alongside legends David Warner, Carlos Brathwaite, Alex Hales, Thisara Perera, Beau Webster, and Shakib Al Hasan.

In 2025, Christopher Balraj was also selected to play in the international T10 league under Shabaz Nadeem alongside Rahul Garg. Furthermore, Rahul Garg and Gokul Krishnan are part of the Cayman Islands national team training squad, working towards representing Cayman internationally.
